mapper.sql: pw.id AS song_id, pw.title, s.artist_name, s.origin_period, s.background_text, s.style_text, s.featured_excerpt, ( SELECT da.storage_uri FROM song_resource sr JOIN digital_asset da ON da.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.song_id = pw.id AND sr.resource_role = 'COVER' ORDER BY sr.display_order, sr.asset_id LIMIT 1 ) AS cover_url, ( SELECT da.storage_uri FROM song_resource sr JOIN digital_asset da ON da.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.song_id = pw.id AND sr.resource_role = 'PREVIEW' ORDER BY sr.display_order, sr.asset_id LIMIT 1 ) AS preview_url, ( SELECT da.storage_uri FROM song_resource sr JOIN digital_asset da ON da.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.song_id = pw.id AND sr.resource_role = 'SCORE' ORDER BY sr.display_order, sr.asset_id LIMIT 1 ) AS score_url, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM song_descriptor sd JOIN descriptor d ON d.id = sd.descriptor_id AND d.enabled = TRUE WHERE sd.song_id = pw.id ) AS descriptor_names

SELECT , NULL AS match_score FROM playable_work pw JOIN song s ON s.work_id = pw.id WHERE AND pw.id = #{songId}

SELECT , CASE WHEN pw.title = #{query} THEN 1.0000 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM song_alias exact_alias WHERE exact_alias.song_id = pw.id AND exact_alias.alias_text = #{query} ) THEN 0.9500 WHEN pw.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 0.8500 WHEN s.artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 0.8000 ELSE 0.7000 END AS match_score FROM playable_work pw JOIN song s ON s.work_id = pw.id WHERE AND ( pw.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR s.artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM song_alias sa WHERE sa.song_id = pw.id AND sa.alias_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY match_score DESC, pw.updated_at DESC, pw.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , CAST(COALESCE( ( SELECT AVG(sd2.weight) FROM song_descriptor sd2 WHERE sd2.song_id = pw.id ), 0.1000 ) AS DECIMAL(5,4)) AS match_score FROM playable_work pw JOIN song s ON s.work_id = pw.id WHERE ORDER BY match_score DESC, pw.updated_at DESC, pw.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO utterance ( session_id, input_channel, intent_type, transcript, audio_asset_id, asr_confidence, vad_duration_ms ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{inputChannel}, #{intentType}, #{transcript}, #{audioAssetId}, #{asrConfidence}, #{vadDurationMs} )
INSERT INTO discovery_request ( session_id, utterance_id, request_kind, status, min_match_score ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{utteranceId}, #{requestKind}, #{status}, #{minMatchScore} )

mapper.update: UPDATE discovery_request SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_run ( session_id, work_id, origin_module, run_status ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{workId}, #{originModule}, #{runStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT pr.id, pr.session_id, pr.work_id, pw.title AS song_title, pr.origin_module, pr.run_status, pr.requested_at, pr.started_at, pr.ended_at FROM performance_run pr JOIN playable_work pw ON pw.id = pr.work_id WHERE pr.id = #{performanceId}
